nodes.label: Scrubbed Consumer Question
nodes.description: A scrubbed consumer-rights question submitted after application-controlled PII removal.

nodes.label: NyayaSetu Orchestrator
nodes.description: Classifies requests, enforces safety boundaries, delegates research and response construction, and assembles the final grounded result.

nodes.label: Consumer Law Research Agent
nodes.description: Converts the question into retrieval queries, invokes hybrid retrieval, validates source relevance, and returns ranked evidence with metadata.

nodes.label: Consumer Guidance Builder
nodes.description: Produces concise procedural guidance using only approved evidence and deterministic jurisdiction results, with citations and limitations.

nodes.label: Evaluation Judge
nodes.description: Grades test responses using the Gold Set rubric, returning scores, rationale, safety status, and a controlled failure category.

nodes.label: Grounded Result
nodes.description: The final structured grounded answer, safe refusal, or automated evaluation result.

edges.label: ranked evidence or controlled retrieval fallback

managed_agents.name: Consumer Law Research Agent
managed_agents.usage_description: Use for redacted consumer-law retrieval, exact legal-reference lookup, hybrid-search/rerank evidence validation, source metadata, and retrieval limitations.

managed_agents.name: Consumer Guidance Builder
managed_agents.usage_description: Use after evidence and deterministic jurisdiction output are available to construct concise procedural guidance, citations, limitations, or a safe refusal/redirect.

managed_agents.name: Evaluation Judge
managed_agents.usage_description: Use for Gold Set evaluation cases when a generated response, reference answer, rubric, and experiment metadata are supplied.
